The integration of LangChain graph nodes for inventory and finance succeeded with a perfect reward score and zero exceptions.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.90 across 1 trial. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_node_checks with zero failed tests. Results were successfully serialized to result.json after a 3m 53s runtime, validating the stability of the adhoc claude-code and gpt-5.2 integration.
